mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 6 degrees now, moderate rain. Next 24 hours: high 8, low 6.

Milan beat Inter 3-1 in the city derby, earning three points in Serie A week ten.

Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti said the 2027 budget, expected to be approved on Monday, will bring record investment in infrastructure.

U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio denied that the United States helped former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro leave Brazil for the United States.

Investment groups from Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates have expressed concrete interest in buying shares of Manchester United.

A protest against the Kosovo government in Tirana lasted more than eight hours, turning violent with police interventions and several incidents.
